$comment: Starling mode-routing resolution document, v1 (E18/E19/E26).
Starter/editable policy: schema_version, the global default profile, the
typed versioned mode entries (identical shape to mode.schema.json) and
the scoped routing rules consumed at activation.
Frozen deterministic precedence, encoded by the executable oracle
tests/mode_routing.py resolve() (ported line-faithful from the review
package reference router):
1. secure-field policy blocks every path (status blocked);
2. a locked explicit manual mode wins and its text stays unparsed for
other modes (request manual_mode + manual_locked, default locked);
3. in an alias-enabled session (take not locked, profile
allow_spoken_overrides true, session_allows_aliases true) a leading
literal escape selects verbatim payload handling;
4. an unambiguous registered leading alias selects its mode: longest
token count, then character length; ties across different modes are
phrase_conflict/needs_resolution, never a guess;
5. otherwise the frozen project/site/app rule wins by scope specificity
(project > site > app), then explicit priority; equal-rank rules
targeting different profiles are rule_conflict/needs_resolution;
equal-rank same-profile ties break by rule id;
6. otherwise the global default profile.
Rules are frozen at activation together with the context snapshot
(context-snapshot.schema.json); a leading phrase recognized later cannot
broaden providers, permissions or the ASR route.
Keyword subset: only keywords the repo's minischema.py fallback
understands are used (the candidate's anyOf/required/pattern constructs
are kept; uniqueItems/maximum were dropped because minischema cannot
check them - the bounds live in the oracle).

version.description: Version of this mode definition; decisions record it as mode_version.

aliases.description: Enabled leading spoken phrases (code this, edit this). Leading-position, whole-token matches only.

allow_spoken_overrides.description: Verbatim flag: false disables this mode's aliases and keeps leading phrases literal. Verbatim modes ship false by default.

vocabulary.description: Scoped recognition-bias terms for this mode; never a provider or permission.

snippets.description: Scoped spoken-to-text expansions applied in this mode only.

transform_kinds.description: Processing kinds this mode asks for, in one model step. Empty means transcribe only: the raw recognition is the output. Providers declare which kinds they support (provider.schema.json); a mode never names a provider.

language.description: Declared dictation language (BCP 47). null means undeclared: only providers that accept any language may process it.

style.description: Closed style axes for clean/format. They map one to one onto the S1-mini control line ([Styling] [Structure] [Context]); instruction providers render them into their prompt.

spoken_commands.description: Deterministic spoken punctuation/layout commands (new line, comma, bullet) run before any model step. A leading 'literal' keeps the next command word as text.

context_fields.description: Which scoped context fields a transform request may carry to the provider. The request records exactly the fields it sent.

processing_delivery.description: direct: raw text is delivered immediately and a processed revision may replace it only while the target is unchanged. staged: output waits in the draft until the user accepts a revision.
